evidence.why: Strict resource guard and unconditional bookkeeping around an unchecked spawn call.
Explicit beam kind and nullable creation result.

facts.rationale: Corrects guaranteed emission to a fallible attempt and preserves resource consumption, effect bookkeeping and ID cadence on allocation failure.
facts.value: Does nothing when xD4C <= 0. Otherwise, if the effect latch is zero, requests effect 0x473 on dynamic bone 4 and sets the latch to one; then consumes one unit of xD4C and attempts one projectile spawn through it_802996D0. The nullable spawn result is ignored. The cadence counter advances modulo six and refreshes xAC4_ignoreItemID on wrap even if projectile creation fails. The current callee constructs It_Kind_L_Gun_Beam.
